thesis: The site is an Acadiana rain almanac: every section is pinned to a month or season, and the services, stories and proof all answer what the plant needs when the rain does this.

signature.name: Rain Almanac Strip
signature.summary: Horizontal Jan-Dec rainfall bar strip with hurricane-season shading; active month fills via --sw-active set by IntersectionObserver. Reused in hero peek, services (peak month), process story, proof review pills, and footer reset. Hook: data-sw-signature='rain-almanac'.

motion.intro: Bayou line draws across SVG map via stroke-dashoffset; town pins fade in. 900ms, skippable.
stories: Rain almanac bars rise month-by-month as strip scrolls horizontally (pinned >=640, stacked cards below).
Process cards clip-reveal on phone; pinned four-step plant walkthrough on desktop.
motion.hover: Hairline grows from left via scaleX(0->1), 200ms, @media (hover:hover).
